001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.helidon27;
002
003import io.helidon.logging.common.spi.LoggingProvider;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
005import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
006
007/**
008 * Bootstraps Rainbow Gum at the exact point Helidon itself bootstraps logging.
009 * <p>
010 * Registered via {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}
011 * ({@code io.helidon.logging.common.LogConfig}'s own static initializer calls
012 * {@link java.util.ServiceLoader#load(Class)} for {@link LoggingProvider}, then
013 * {@link LoggingProvider#initialization()} on whichever candidate sorts first). Confirmed
014 * by decompiling {@code LogConfig}: candidates are ordered by
015 * {@code io.helidon.common.Weighted} weight, descending, and the very first call any
016 * Helidon-generated {@code Main} class makes is {@code LogConfig.initClass()}, forcing
017 * that static initializer (and therefore this class's {@link #initialization()}) to run
018 * before config, the service registry, or the webserver ever starts, and well before any
019 * application log line.
020 * <p>
021 * No {@code @Weight} annotation needed here: the default weight
022 * ({@value io.helidon.common.Weighted#DEFAULT_WEIGHT}) already beats
023 * {@code io.helidon.logging.jul.JulProvider}'s own {@code @Weight(1)} (confirmed by
024 * decompiling it), so this provider is picked automatically whenever both are on the
025 * classpath, no exclusion or configuration required.
026 * <p>
027 * Depends on {@code rainbowgum-jul} at runtime (see this module's {@code pom.xml}):
028 * calling {@link RainbowGum#of()} here only bootstraps Rainbow Gum itself. Actually
029 * routing {@code java.util.logging.Logger} calls (Helidon's own facade) through it is a
030 * separate step, {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.jul.JULConfigurator}, which runs
031 * automatically as part of that same bootstrap sequence as long as {@code rainbowgum-jul}
032 * is present.
033 */
034@ServiceProvider(LoggingProvider.class)
035public final class RainbowGumLoggingProvider implements LoggingProvider {
036
037        /**
038         * For {@link java.util.ServiceLoader}.
039         */
040        public RainbowGumLoggingProvider() {
041        }
042
043        @Override
044        public void initialization() {
045                RainbowGum.of();
046        }
047
048        @Override
049        public void runTime() {
050                /*
051                 * Only called under GraalVM native-image, after the image has actually started
052                 * (LogConfig.configureRuntime() no-ops on a regular JVM). Not attempted yet:
053                 * whether a native-image build of a Helidon app needs anything different here
054                 * (re-resolving properties that were frozen at build time, for example) is real,
055                 * separate work. See rainbowgum-jul-logmanager's own javadoc for the kind of
056                 * build-time/run-time split GraalVM support in this project usually needs, and
057                 * treat this as a placeholder until that's been verified against a real
058                 * native-image build of this module.
059                 */
060        }
061
062}
